activity.notes: Jürgen Wullenwever served as burgomaster of Lübeck from 1533 to 1535. ATLAS records the office he actually held rather than treating him as a sovereign ruler of the Hanseatic League.

sources.title: Jürgen Wullenwever — Lübeck burgomaster, 1533–1535
sources.citation_text: Biographical chronology identifies Wullenwever as Lübeck burgomaster from 1533 to 1535 and a major actor in Lübeck's Hanseatic policy.

sources.title: Jürgen Wullenwever — Encyclopaedia Britannica tradition
sources.citation_text: Standard biographical accounts identify Wullenwever as Lübeck burgomaster and a central political actor during the Count's Feud.
